text:
Nora (Product): quick sync on catalog UX: badge density, pin affordance, and filter persistence.

Evan (Design): uploaded compact frames: show up to 3 badges inline + a '+n' overflow, pin icon visible on focus, pinned items appear as a small chip in header. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/compact.

Sam (Eng): +1 to +n overflow to limit paint. implement overflow as a lightweight popover. pin must be a real button (not hover-only) so keyboard users can access it.

Priya (A11y): agree. accessibility checklist: native button with aria-label='Pin version for compare', aria-pressed toggles, aria-live region to announce changes, and badge text contrast >= 4.5:1.

Evan (Design): microcopy options for tooltip: 'Keep in compare' vs 'Pin for compare'. I prefer 'Keep in compare'.

Nora (Product): customers want pinned sets shareable. suggestion: encode pins in URL query: '?pins=md1234:v2.1'. support localStorage aliasing for long lists.

Sam (Eng): URL encoding works. plan: read pins from URL on load, validate via metadata endpoint, fallback to nearest compatible version or show a 'Select replacement' CTA if missing. keep UI stable.

Priya (A11y): for sparklines in metric popovers add a hidden text summary like 'p95 latency trend: 120ms to 110ms' so screen readers get numbers. Ensure +n popover is keyboard navigable.

Nora (Product): next steps: Evan update comps to show keyboard focus states & +n popover, Sam spike URL param handling, Priya publish a short a11y checklist. OpsBot created ticket PROD-UX-501 assigned.

Evan (Design): will push new frames today.

Sam (Eng): will spike this sprint.

Priya (A11y): will add checklist to the spec doc.

Nora (Product): thanks all. Drop copy nits here and I'll fold them into the tooltip/modal text. :thumbsup:
